method.returns: NAV ratios; no distributions or splits in common window; after fund expenses, before investor fees
method.daily_risk: own observations within identical dates; annualization uses observed return count / elapsed years
method.statistics: Complete-month paired log returns; HAC/Newey-West 6 lags, asymptotic normal p; Holm across 3 comparisons; circular paired block bootstrap 10000 draws, blocks 12 and 6 months, fixed seed
method.limitations: Overlapping rolling windows are descriptive, not independent trials or future probabilities. Historical product returns are not isolated manager alpha. Different regional allocations, FX, leverage and fee histories. No forecasting or causal attribution.
